name: quota-guard
description: Claude Code mod: refuses new subagent (Agent) calls while the 5-hour usage window is at or above a threshold (default 85%), and toasts once when it crosses. Fails open if usage is unavailable.

threshold.title: Block subagents at this percent of the 5-hour window (default 85)
threshold.description: A number from 1 to 100. While the 5-hour window is at or above it, new Agent calls are refused until the window resets.
